claim: In the HWA laboratory, the JobManager REST endpoint (JobManagerRESTWeb/JobScheduler/job on port 31116) is reachable over HTTPS and issued an LtpaToken2 cookie after basic authentication, but returned fault AWSJMR011E ServiceUnavailable. The JobManagerGW has autostart=no (direct topology), so the JobManager REST service is not available for external job submission without the broker/gateway component.
notes: The direct MDM topology without the gateway does not expose the external JobManager REST job-submission service.
